name: Junior Volunteer Program (Suburban Hospital)
what_you_do: Help at a hospital in Bethesda for 4 hours a week. Teen helpers often push the Art Cart and Comfort Cart or work at the front desk. You meet patients, families and staff.
who_can_apply: High school students who are at least 16 years old.
duration: At least 6 months, one 4-hour shift a week.
deadline_text: All fall 2026 junior spots are full. The page says to check back beginning in February 2027 for spring and summer openings.
how_to_apply: First go to a free info session in person. Then fill out the teen volunteer form. You also go to a training and show your shots: MMR, chicken pox, Tdap, and a flu shot in flu season.
notes: Junior volunteer spots open by season and fill up. Volunteers get free parking and free flu shots. Questions: shvolunteerservices@jh.edu or 301-896-3092.
